issues.problem: The dispatch asks to CLOSE the sorries of theo:local_virt_tame. One remains, on the fully general piece (2). It is justified as 'blocked by a MATHEMATICAL obstruction, not by infrastructure': the paper's (D) (l.2128-2133) needs r⁻¹(R) portly for r^*T_α, i.e. lem:spread_top (c) for r. I checked WP-27k's GX.cex_spread_top_sector, GX.not_spreadTopConnCE and GX.isPortly_strongPullTop_iff_local in SpreadTop.lean. They are sorry-free and say what is claimed, so the obstruction is real FOR r. But the proved substitute, IsLiftableChartMap, demands that the components Û of p⁻¹(U) and V̂ of q⁻¹(V) be homeomorphic over φ, i.e. that BOTH ℓ : Ũ → Û and r : Ṽ → V̂ be isomorphisms. The checklist says 'without it the proof's (D) fails', which holds only for the r half. When r is an isomorphism and ℓ is not, the paper's construction meets no spread_top (c) issue, as each step of the proof shows. (1) r^*T_α = T_α on V̂ (strongPullTop of a homeomorphism with T_α locally connected, cf. GX.strongPullTop_self). (2) (D) for Ṽ = V̂ is (D) of T_α restricted to the open V̂. (3) Û gets the quotient topology of Ũ ≅ V̂ by Γ(Ũ/Û). Portliness passes to Û as the paper argues (l.2128-2131): the regular part is saturated and ℓ is open and surjective. (4) (B) descends because D∘ℓ = g·D_U on reg Ũ. (5) Galoisianity of ℓ is GX.isGaloisian_of_comp. Nothing there is a known-false step; what is missing is the ℓ-quotient construction, which REPORT's own question estimates at ~1.5k lines. That is infrastructure. The r-iso / ℓ-arbitrary case is not marginal. 'Ṽ → V̂ iso for small V' is a condition on the MODELS alone, like the paper's other hypotheses, whereas IsLiftableChartMap constrains M. It covers the case where a local meridian dies in π₁(reg M) but not in π₁(reg X_α). So the row's proved form is weaker than the strongest form the paper's proof supports (DEC-27 asks for the strongest), and the sorry's tag misdescribes what blocks the excluded ℓ-nontrivial case.
issues.fix: Either (preferred) prove the stronger form: replace IsLiftableChartMap by a condition on r only. That is, for the chart's V, Ṽ → V̂ an isomorphism, a model-side hypothesis; better still, StrongLocallyConnectedOrd for r^*T_α (GX.isPortly_strongPullTop_iff_local), which subsumes it. Then build T_{U,V,φ} on Û as the ℓ-quotient of the transported topology. This keeps the general sorry only where r violates the local condition. Or, at minimum, correct the record. In the checklist row, the sorry comment and REPORT, say that the ℓ-iso half of IsLiftableChartMap is an infrastructure restriction (the ℓ-quotient is unbuilt) and that only the r half is forced by the spread_top (c) obstruction. List the ℓ-quotient as unbuilt work in REPORT notes. The row stays partial in both cases unless a ruling accepts a corrected form.
